brief: Answers a whole-object condition after a type guard such as IsAPairQ has passed.
detail: A passing type guard returns this guard instead of a true value, so that Where can test a condition against the whole object once: in o.IsAPairQ().Where('isString(@pair[1]) and isNumber(@pair[2])') the keyword @pair stands for the pair itself, not for each of its items. A failing guard returns a stzFalseObject whose Where answers 0. Content and Value give back the guarded object's content, and Object the object.
